definition: PostgreSQL is an open-source relational database system supporting SQL, transactions and extensible data features.
entry_text: PostgreSQL is an open-source relational database system supporting SQL, transactions and extensible data features.
example: A service stores orders and queries them using joins and aggregates.
label: PostgreSQL

sources.note: The project documents open-source SQL, transactions and extensibility through custom types, functions and extensions. Object-relational is the project’s more specific classification; relational is accurate at this level.
